spec.description: Every radar the service tracks -- NEXRAD (WSR-88D), terminal Doppler (TDWR) and wind profilers -- each with its data latency and status.

request.title: ListRadarStationsRequest
request.description: Which radars. Every filter is optional. Give one value to `stationType`: the service reads several only comma-separated, and this client sends them as repeated keys, of which the service keeps the last.

stationType.description: Kinds of radar to narrow to: `WSR-88D`, `TDWR` or `Profiler`, matched case-sensitively (`tdwr` answers an empty list). Undocumented, so not enumerated.

reportingHost.description: Monitoring host to report status and latency from. `rdss` is the only one the service knew on 2026-10-01; any other value answers 503.

host.description: LDM host to measure `latency` at, such as `ldm1`. Without it, `ldm4` on 2026-10-01; a host the service does not know answers 503.

response.title: RadarStationCollection
response.description: The radars, as a GeoJSON feature collection.

items.description: One radar. A list leaves `performance` and `adaptation` out; `radar.get_station` has them.

notes: Every radar, about 500 KB: 208 on 2026-10-01 (159 WSR-88D, 45 TDWR, 4 profilers). The service does not page the list.

The example narrows to the four profilers, the smallest kind and the one whose `rda` and `latency` are all null. The other kinds were validated against this schema live on 2026-10-01, every one of the 208 through `radar.get_station`.
